description: Source code for user profile picture handling in Mattermost, including generating default images, reading/writing profile images, and font management.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service handling user profile images, including retrieval, default image creation, and file storage interactions.

methods.name: GetProfileImage
methods.description: Retrieves the profile image for a user, returning default if none exists.

methods.name: FileBackend
methods.description: Initializes and returns the file storage backend used for profile images.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads a file from the storage backend.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file in the storage backend.

methods.name: GetDefaultProfileImage
methods.description: Generates a default profile image for a user, either bot or user initial.
